title: Naomi Watts and Jane Fonda suit up while Cristin Milioti dons a chic dress for 2025 Producers Guild Awards
text:
Naomi Watts, Jane Fonda and Cristin Milioti looked fabulous and fashionable, since they attended the 2025 producers’ guild awards in Los Angeles on Saturday night.
Watts, 56, looked incredible with a black stripe pants suit with a buttoned white shirt and a loose backtie.
He added a pair of pointed black footwear and wore a square black bag, sliding his short blond hair back and adding a red lipstick slide.
On the other hand, Fonda, 87, seemed younger than his years when he left with a pink dusty monochromatic outfit that included a armored blazer and chopped pants.
Milioti, 39, arrived with a black halter neck dress with her dark hair.
The Producers’ Guild Awards ceremony took place on February 8, 2025 in Fairmont’s square.

Taika Waititi was honored with the Norman Lear award at the Saturday event.
